headline: Kraków shooting latest updates: five killed and more than a dozen injured, police say

members.title: Kraków shooting latest updates: five killed and more than a dozen injured, police say
members.lead: Six people have been killed and 16 injured after a gunman opened fire in a busy market square in Kraków on Saturday in what Poland’s defence minister, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, called an “act of terror” on the people of the city. The suspect, a 25-year-old Polish citizen, opened fire with an automatic weapon from inside a car in the city’s main square at about 3pm. He was fascinated with far-right ideologies and held “very radical” and “ultra-nationalistic” views, the Polish interior minister, Marcin Kierwiński, said. Authorities said the gunman was dressed in “military-style” clothes and used a long military-type firearm. Four women and two men were killed, one of them a British citizen, Polish police said. Three of the victims were Polish women and the remaining two victims had not been identified.
